decision_rationale: Geneverse is presented as a new collection of finetuned LLMs/MLLMs for genomic and proteomic tasks, with explicit text prompts and generation of gene-function descriptions. The fact that it reuses open-source foundation models does not make it a wrapper here because the paper centers a new multimodal model collection and generative task setup.
evidence_snippet: “finetuned LLMs and multimodal LLMs (MLLMs), known as Geneverse” and “accepts the prompt P(T, I, m) as input, where T represents the text description”
